No single authoritative document existed describing what has been built, when, and how ΓÇö making it impossible to reason about system state across production, staging, and the open PR queue.

## `IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md` (604 lines)

### Environment Architecture
- Branch ΓåÆ Vercel URL ΓåÆ Supabase DB mapping (corrects misunderstanding: `production` branch deploys to a Preview URL, not `cubiqo.ai` ΓÇö only `main` is real prod)
- CI/CD pipeline: Vercel auto-deploy per branch, GitHub Actions (`ci.yml`, `chromatic.yml`, `self-heal-cron.yml`)

### 12 Open PRs ΓÇö each with root cause + tech delta
Most critical: PR #183 (camera/audio fully broken by `Permissions-Policy: camera=()` + missing `data:` in `media-src`), PR #184 (RGY SIGNAL Step 3 silently swallowed ΓÇö `showRoomChat` state set but no renderer), PR #176 (hardcoded `admin@cubiqo.ai` bypass removed)

### 20 Feature Techno-Functional Specs ΓÇö implementation date + full stack detail per feature
AI engine (policy router zones: YELLOW/GREEN/RED/REASONING/FOUNDER/FREEDOM), BYO Mode (AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2/100k), Voice (Groq Whisper STT + ElevenLabs TTS state machine), CQ-to-CQ (WebRTC + Supabase Realtime signalling), Founders Pass (OAuth per 6 providers, encrypted token storage), Social Army (Railway Puppeteer worker, 9 platforms), Emergent Studio (Worlds pattern, Docker sandboxing), Verbal Commands (12 Puppeteer service drivers), Unified Notifications (27-platform registry), Cubiqo Wallet (QR escrow, no third-party processor), and 10 more.

### 38-Migration DB Inventory
Full table ΓÇö date, file, purpose ΓÇö from initial schema (Nov 2025) through wallet schema (Feb 20, 2026).

### Full Route Inventory
All public, admin (`/admin/*`, gated `is_admin=true`), Founders Pass (`/founders-pass/*`, gated tier), and demo routes.
